payload.description: Issue #2: FINAL HARDENING — sync exact runtime Casinobabe.lua before fixing WoW crash
requirements: 1. RUNTIME PARITY: Identify exact Casinobabe.lua running in WoW, compute SHA256, compare with working tree/branch
2. SYNC: Synchronize canonical version if safe, create rollback backup, revalidate hash
3. REPRODUCE: Create deterministic offline reproduction test for the WoW crash
4. REGRESSION TEST: Convert bug to regression test (fail before fix, pass after)
5. MINIMAL FIX: Implement root cause fix with clear rationale
6. MASS VALIDATION: Run target reproduction + unit tests + harness + simulator + full regression suite
6. SIMULATOR: Extract minimum components for offline execution (tests/simulator/, tests/scenarios/, tests/fixtures/)
7. CI INSPECTION: Classify current CI failure (CasinoBae Addon Tests) - real regression, env issue, flaky, outdated, or expected
8. PR TO MERGE: Go all the way to MERGED, not just PR CREATED
9. LIVE VERIFY: Sync to WoW, verify SHA, trigger live scenario, verify no crash, verify LiveErrorCapture clean
10. AUTO-REGRESSION: If live verification fails, auto-create factory event → reproduce → regression test → repair
